review.notes: Full read-through of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 11 physical pages; physical pages 1, 6 (Table 1 header crop) and 7 (footnote crop) were rendered and visually checked. Code fences: none in the OCR markdown; references [1]-[32] all present. Kept as printed by the PDF (not defects): "15B Models" without + in Table 3 (Tables 1-2 print "15B+ Models"), "arXiv e-prints, pages arXiv-2506, 2025" in [1], "Accessed: 2024-07-24" in [2], "Equation. 10", "evaluation of all stage \"v1-v6\"", "Gemini-Diffusion" in section 4 ("Gemini Diffusion" elsewhere), "1055 problems". The chart-legend line ("Seed Diffusion Preview Gemini Diffusion Mercury Coder(small) Mercury Coder(mini) Seed Coder Instruct") is figure-internal text of the embedded Figure 1 and was left in place per the figure-internal-text rule.
